key_stat: Major European bank | Investment banking | DWS asset management | dbX
summary: Deutsche Bank is undergoing multi-year transformation under CEO Christian Sewing. Investment bank (top 10 global), corporate bank, private bank, DWS (asset management, €963B AUM). Technology modernisation: cloud migration (Google Cloud partnership), platform consolidation, AI deployment. Significant vendor spend. Post-2019 restructuring executing well.

business_segments.name: Investment Bank
business_segments.detail: FICC, equities, advisory. Top 10 global. Growing market share.

business_segments.name: Corporate Bank
business_segments.detail: Transaction banking, trade finance, cash management. German corporates.

business_segments.name: Private Bank
business_segments.detail: Wealth management Germany + international. Postbank retail.

business_segments.name: DWS
business_segments.detail: €963B AUM. Listed AM subsidiary. Passive + active.

technology.ai: AI for trading, risk management, credit decisioning, compliance monitoring, customer service. Growing GenAI capabilities. Bernd Leukert (ex-SAP) driving data and AI strategy.
technology.cloud: Google Cloud strategic partnership (multi-year). Major cloud migration programme. Hybrid approach with on-premises for critical systems.
technology.data: Significant data quality and governance improvement programme. Risk data aggregation. Regulatory reporting. Client analytics. Bernd Leukert leading data transformation.
technology.platforms: dbX ecosystem (digital banking and API platform). Trading platforms (Autobahn). Postbank retail platform. DWS (Xtrackers). Global Hausbank strategy for corporate clients.
technology.spend: Multi-billion annual technology investment. Google Cloud commitment. SAP-grade technology leadership via Bernd Leukert.

operating_model: Multi-year transformation. Google Cloud partnership. Platform consolidation. Cost reduction ongoing. Vendor spend significant.

people.name: Bernd Leukert
people.role: CTO and Member of Management Board. Leads Technology, Data and Innovation. Ex-SAP Executive Board (Products & Innovation).

people.name: Jürg Zeltner
